data.control_account: 1.04.02.05.03.01- CS_SEIT MMIII SKDC_A Node Integration, Assembly, Test, & Checkout
data.leadership_messages: WBS definition was incorrect and pointed to STOS systems engineering which is false for this element. The CAM provided the following WBS definition which somehow got lost in handoff between NG and GOV, “This element includes all effort of technical and functional activities associated with the design, development, and production of mating surfaces, structures, equipment, parts, materials, and software required to assemble, test, and checkout the subsystem equipment (hardware/software) elements at the Command and Launch (C&L) Node level for the Minuteman III (MMIII) Key Distribution Center (SKDC) capability as a part of the IFC 2.0/Delivery/Installation/OUE Complete (DIOC) Test Campaign. This includes necessary integration and testing on the strategic Command (STRATCOM) Key Distribution Center (SKDC) which supports the execution of the SLP-A mission.” 2. A total of 8 combined planned and work packages under this CA. 3. CA is focused on SKDC node level (L3) testing activities.
data.rationale: There is moderate confidence that the prime contractor has established mature planning of work packages supporting MMIII SKDC node level integration and testing. Assessment requires P6 and BOEs to make a thorough and complete evaluation of the CA.

areas.text: Aside from WBS dictionary and definitions having incorrect/outdated information in the artifacts provided to the GOV for review, the NG CAM owner provided an updated WBS definition. The work packages captures the high level program objectives giving confidence in the contractor’s planning maturity and readiness.
Scope is sufficiently captured in work and planning packages to support IIR #2, however, P6 will be required for subsequent review in order to make a complete and full assessment.
Element covers SKDC node level 3 test activities.
